text: Сколько у бэкера времени, чтобы исправить адрес, куда слать коробку?
note: Answer is a denial in English ("no changes later than 14 days after the pledge manager closes"). Traps: refunds 30 days in the same message and in the plan.

text: Will the deluxe edition come with metal coins?
note: Only if the campaign reaches €120,000 (stretch goal); answer in Russian. Traps: €35,000 goal, €50k/€80k stretches.

text: Фабрика одобрила цвета на пробной печати карт?
note: Factory approved the dieline/box template only; the colour proof was not checked. Kirill's 'Фабрика всё одобрила' over-claims.

text: Did we decide to add a single-player mode?
note: Daniel's solo-mode proposal was deferred every time ('после кампании', 'parking it', 'after launch').

text: Сколько бэкер платит за базовую коробку?
note: Plan says €49 without shipping; Daniel pushes €55 with shipping and put it as a page placeholder; never decided. Deluxe €79 is a trap.

text: When does the campaign go live?
note: Plan says 23 June; Kirill (in Russian) insists on 7 July after the colour proof; Anna never decided. Max Hollis's June 16 submission deadline is a trap.

text: How many cards are in the core box?
note: Yulia (Russian) says 180, the factory quote says 216; nobody decided. 120 event cards, 54 per sheet are traps.

text: Who's handling shipping to EU backers now?
note: ShipNest (included in pledge) was agreed and is still in the plan; Kirill's short Russian reply switches to Fulfilio. Old message shares far more words with the question.

text: Из чего в итоге делаем фигурки героев?
note: Plastic minis agreed by Kirill and still in the plan; Anna's two-word reply 'Минек не будет. Стенди.' cancels it.

text: Are backer-only promo cards still part of the campaign?
note: Backer-exclusive promo pack agreed in May and still in the plan; dropped on 3 June because of retailers.

text: К какому числу иллюстратор Макс обещал готовые картинки для карт?
note: Two Maxes: illustrator Max Rudenko — final event art by 12 June (drafts 29 May); Backerly manager Max Hollis — June 16 page deadline and May 30 featured slot.

text: How heavy is the core box?
note: Weight is never stated (open question). Traps: 30×30×7 cm, 2 mm board, shipping tiers by kg.
Qingmu minimum 1,500 copies (English). Traps: 2,000 for better price, Polish factory 1,000, "мечтаю о 3 000", 4,000 per container.

text: What is the funding target on Backerly?
note: €35,000 (stated in Russian and in the plan). Traps: last campaign 28,000 goal / 41k raised, stretches.
